items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: He used to be with Slow Drag.

ctx.x: You told us about that I think the other time we made the tape. Yeah, it's a call sandpaper. Like a drummer does.
And then after that this fellow here, George, but he's dead now I guess. He used to be with Slow Drag. Yeah. He picked it up after me. And with Loon and all too, I think. Yeah, that's Loon.

items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: I know Fede Keppett and Louis Keppett.

ctx.x: I was wondering if that was Adolph Alexander's father. I don't know.
I know Fede Keppett and Louis Keppett. Oh? Yeah. See, they had a band too, you see.
